_this_field_is_not_called_preregistratio: a live preregistration hash is a thing a launcher binds to. This document binds nothing and must not be loadable as though it did.
_contract: The DESIGN THAT WAS WITHDRAWN. It was preregistered and withdrawn on the same day, before any A-bsz3 structural or behavioural result existed, so it decided nothing and no measurement was taken under it. It is kept because a withdrawal that leaves no trace reads later as a design that never happened, and because one of its findings survives the withdrawal.

what_it_proposed.design: 8 seeds x 2 arms = 16 probes, both arms freshly trained

why_it_was_withdrawn.reason: SCOPE, not power. A-bsz3 is an execution-optimization validation. The programme does not need a >=90%-power population-level non-inferiority claim to decide whether a batching knob is worth switching on; it needs to establish that bsz3 materially reduces execution cost without a material downstream regression.
why_it_was_withdrawn._the_design_was_not_wrong_about_its_own_: it was answering a question nobody had asked, at sixteen probes' cost.

the_power_finding.claim: non-inferiority at a given margin needs MORE data than superiority at the same margin, because the null and the alternative swap places
the_power_finding._why_it_still_matters: it is the reason the shortened study MUST NOT be reported as a non-inferiority conclusion. Three seeds cannot support that claim; the successor design does not make it.
the_power_finding._see_also: the same arithmetic, in the general form, is recorded as the `noninferiority-needs-more-data` finding

the_margin_derivation.claim: a non-inferiority margin is bounded BELOW by the instrument's precision and ABOVE by what the programme will tolerate losing
the_margin_derivation._consequence: margins of 0.0050 and 0.0075 sit below the worst observed half-width, so a PERFECTLY EQUIVALENT protocol could not clear them. A criterion no true negative can pass is not a criterion.
the_margin_derivation._where_it_is_used_now: nowhere as a criterion. The successor reports the programme's 0.010 SESOI as the SCALE of a material loss, not as a confidence bound to clear.

what_survives_the_withdrawal.the_implementation: untouched and accepted: A-bsz3 is canonical A under two ExecutionConfig fields, has no implementation id of its own, and imports nothing from causal-KL. Giving the knob an impl id would have answered the equivalence question by definition.
what_survives_the_withdrawal.the_zero_cost_analysis: unchanged: 67 forwards -> 23 (0.3433x) for +4.01% executed positions, from the frozen mixture's real lengths.
what_survives_the_withdrawal.the_registered_prediction: unchanged and still unresolved: the artifact digests are predicted NOT to match.

what_the_successor_changed: step 2 trains at most THREE probes, treatment only
the control arm is attempt75's three existing A_incumbent probes, reused
a fail-fast order with a stop threshold DERIVED from C3's own observed per-seed spread
the 1.25x runtime adoption bar, inherited from the causal-KL packing pilot, is removed; the measured speedup is reported instead
no 95% non-inferiority conclusion may be drawn
the cross-session claim boundary is stated explicitly, because reusing controls from another session is the whole saving and also its main cost
